intro: This chapter documents the Storm Breaker robot software (MakeX 2026). It is generated automatically from the Doxygen comments in Robot.py.

decisions.title: Single file for the NovaPi
decisions.decision: The whole program lives in one file, Robot.py.
decisions.rationale: The mBuild NovaPi loads a single Python script; keeping everything together avoids import problems and makes quick changes at a competition easier.

decisions.title: Mecanum kinematics with mounting-dependent signs
decisions.decision: Checar_Velocidades computes v1..v4 and Vel_Motores inverts M2 and M4.
decisions.rationale: Separating computation from application allows the kinematics to be tested without moving motors; the right-side motors are mounted in the opposite direction.

decisions.title: Manual control always active
decisions.decision: The joysticks drive the chassis on every iteration of main(), even after a button is pressed.
decisions.rationale: The driver keeps control of the chassis and can interrupt mechanism actions.

decisions.title: 28 s tag-based autonomous
decisions.decision: Button N1 runs Comparacion_QR in a loop bounded by novapi.timer() < 28.
decisions.rationale: The autonomous period is 30 s; a 2 s margin avoids overlapping the manual period.

decisions.title: Pixel to cm conversion
decisions.decision: Camera distances are divided by 16.84 px/cm.
decisions.rationale: Constant obtained from calibrating a 10 cm tag; it must be recalibrated if the camera or its position changes.

decisions.title: Time-based autonomous movement
decisions.decision: Mov_Auto moves the robot for a fixed time instead of using the distance it receives.
decisions.rationale: Provisional solution; converting distance to speed/time is pending calibration.
